quote: Kynea numbers were first studied and defined by Cletus Emmanuel in 1995
note: The problem of infinitely many Kynea primes follows naturally from the definition of Kynea numbers (4^n + 2^(n+1) - 1), part of a broader class of problems about prime infinitude in special forms. Cletus Emmanuel defined these numbers in 1995 and named them after a person. He searched up to index 15,000 for Kynea primes.
